description: This file defines the LocationUtility class, a utility class for managing location-related operations within the OpenMRS system, including retrieving and setting default locations and reacting to global property changes.

classes.name: LocationUtility
classes.description: A utility class for working with openmrs Location objects, managing default location cache, and reacting to global property changes.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation
methods.description: Returns the cached default location, fetching from the context if not already cached and the session is open.

methods.name: getUserDefaultLocation
methods.description: Returns the location preference of the current user.

methods.name: setDefaultLocation
methods.description: Sets the cached default location to a new Location object.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when a global property has changed by resetting the cached default location.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a global property is deleted by resetting the cached default location.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the provided property name matches the recognized global property for default location.
